placements.title: measured performance gains justify committing to new technology
placements.frame: What measured performance evidence drives a technology adoption, and how does a principal's declaration ratify the commitment?
placements.why: src-2 performs the adoption declaration with proportional justification (15x faster columnar queries), and src-3 records it as a ratified decision. The theme — adopting new technology because measurable performance gains justify the switch — is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding as the migration progresses and outcomes are evaluated. The 15x figure is evidence for this theme, not a leaf itself.
